glossary.title: Company glossary
glossary.intro: Every COSMO word has a precise meaning. A role says what you CAN do; a position in the org chart says whom you manage.

defs.owner: The person who created the company in COSMO and holds its subscription. There is only one; they can hand this role over. They are also an administrator.
defs.admin: A ROLE: full rights (invite, organise the org chart, set everyone’s permissions). There can be several.
defs.manager: A POSITION, not a role: anyone with at least one person reporting to them in the org chart. They see Statistics and the Org chart for their scope.
defs.teamLead: The person appointed to run a cross-functional team. It is neither a role nor a reporting position: you can lead a team without managing anyone in the org chart.
defs.member: Anyone in the company. Their default rights can be widened or narrowed by an administrator (Members → Edit permissions).
defs.team: A group of people, independent from the org chart (someone can belong to several teams). A project or objective attached to a team is visible to that team only.
defs.project: A set of tasks with an owner, dates and a chosen colour. Every team task belongs to a project.
defs.category: A thematic classification shared by projects, tasks and objectives, organised as a tree. It has its own colour and does not change a project’s colour.
